<<MENDING OF FISHING NETS, BRIEFLY>>

THE MENDING OF FISHING NETS IS A HONEST AND DUTIOUS TASK THAT IS DONE BY LOCAL FISHERS. IT IS A WAY OF REPAIRING THE NETS THAT HAVE BEEN TORN OR DROPPED BY THE WIND OR BY THE CURRENT. THE PROCESS INCLUSES REPAIRING THE TORN PLACES WITH STRANDS OF STRONG THREAD AND REPAIRING THE WEAK SPOTS WITH STRONG WOOD. THE MENDING IS DONE IN A PLACE CALLED [MEETING TIME], WHERE THE FISHERS MEET TO SHARE THEIR EXPERIENCES AND TO WORK TOGETHER TO REPAIR THE NETS. THE NET SIZE IS IMPORTANT DURING THE MENDING PROCESS, AS IT AFFECTS HOW THE NET IS REPAIRED. THE BOAT NAME IS USED TO IDENTIFY THE NET AND TO MAKE SURE THAT THE RIGHT NET IS REPAIRED. THE WOOD TYPE IS USED TO MAKE SURE THAT THE REPAIR IS STRONG AND LASTING.
